title: In situ thermal polymerization of hydrogel suppresses Leidenfrost effect up to 1,000°C for high-temperature thermal management
authors: Junhao Li, Zhenghao Guo, Zhi Huang, Kang Liu
abstract: A zwitterionic monomer solution suppresses the Leidenfrost effect up to 1,000°C via thermally triggered in situ polymerization. This yields a cooling efficiency four times that of pure water in spray cooling at 1,000°C and halves the cooling time during battery thermal runaway.
